resources.text:
# Supported dev boards

The `board_model` wire values a board reports over Lamella Link:

| model | board |
|--:|---|
| 0 | custom board |
| 1 | BBC micro:bit v1 |
| 2 | Raspberry Pi Pico 2 |
| 3 | SAM4S Xplained Pro |
| 4 | SAME54 Xplained Pro |
| 5 | SAMD21 Xplained Pro |
| 6 | ATSAMW25 Xplained Pro |
| 7 | STM32F091 Nucleo-64 |
| 8 | STM32L476 Nucleo |
| 9 | Arduino MKR1000 |
| 10 | Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W |
| 11 | BBC micro:bit v2 |
| 12 | Arduino Zero |
| 13 | Raspberry Pi Pico |
| 14 | Espressif ESP32-C6 |13, USB `1209:0001`
- **Espressif ESP32-C6** (`esp32c6`, null) — board_model 14

Run `lamella_identify_device` on a connected board to read its `board_model` + chip IDCODE live.
